findings.title: Category fabricators deleted and replaced with embeddable_host fabricator
findings.body: The diff replaces the entire contents of category_fabricator.rb (the :category, :diff_category, :happy_category and :private_category fabricators) with the :embeddable_host fabricator. The category fabricators are re-added in embeddable_host_fabricator.rb, so the two files look swapped. The :embeddable_host fabricator is defined in this file, which now has the wrong name for its contents. Fabrication loads every file in the directory, so the specs may still pass, but the files no longer match the fabricators they define, which is confusing and fragile.

findings.title: Migration crashes when embed_category setting is absent
findings.body: The query is `execute(...)[0]['id']`. When no `embed_category` row exists, which is the default because the setting defaulted to '', the result set is empty. `[0]` is then nil and `nil['id']` raises NoMethodError, so the migration fails on most installs. The line 15 lookup of `uncategorized_category_id` has the same risk. The fallback `if category_id == 0` is never reached.

findings.title: Unescaped host value interpolated into SQL
findings.body: The host strings from the old site setting are interpolated directly into the INSERT statement. A value containing a quote breaks the migration or allows SQL injection. Hosts are also not stripped of `http://` or whitespace, and `\r` is not handled, so migrated rows may fail the model's format validation.

findings.title: Case-insensitive lookup compares against non-lowercased host
findings.body: The query is `lower(host) = ?` but the bound value `uri.host` is not downcased. URL hosts with uppercase letters, such as `Example.com`, will not match. `URI()` does not normalise the case of the host.

findings.title: before_validation mutates host in place and crashes on nil
findings.body: `self.host.sub!` raises NoMethodError when host is nil, for example when a request omits the param. `sub!` also mutates the string that was passed in. The format regex accepts a path, but the callback strips it first. `host_allowed?` also ignores the port, so a host saved with a port never matches.

findings.title: Missing record causes nil errors (500) in update/destroy
findings.body: `EmbeddableHost.where(id: ...).first` returns nil for an unknown id. `save_host(nil)` and `host.destroy` then raise NoMethodError and the response is a 500 instead of a 404. A missing `params[:embeddable_host]` also raises.

findings.title: Save sends the key `host` but the buffered value is wrapped incorrectly
findings.body: On a new record `categoryId` is never initialised because only `edit` sets it. The server falls back to the uncategorized category instead of the chosen one. The `delete` action also calls `sendAction` after the record is destroyed, with no error handling.

findings.title: saveChanges does nothing useful
findings.body: `saveChanges` calls `update({})`, and the server `update` action does nothing but re-render. It is also not referenced from the template.
